purpose: Entry point for all Grade 1-6 concept intelligence profiles.
resolver_rules: Resolve each concept ID in exactly one profile file.
Use the registry for representation and teaching-move IDs.
An empty curriculum_refs array means curriculum mapping is still required; do not infer placement.
An empty misconception_ids or diagnostic_question_ids array means that diagnostic content is still required; do not invent it at render time.
Keep evidence status from the source record. Joining records does not increase confidence.
Use England when referring to the statutory National Curriculum in England.
Treat Common Core as a US comparison baseline, not a single US curriculum.
Do not use legacy PEP sequence as the current sequence.

copy_style.rule: Teacher-facing copy must be direct, instructional and specific.
